evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/ui/g is constructed by ClientUI and registered directly with the frame via addWindowListener.
windowClosing optionally shows the exact 'Are you sure you want to exit?' / 'Exit' confirmation, logs the matching warning on exception, and invokes ClientUI shutdown when the result is OK.
RuneLite ClientUI installs an anonymous WindowAdapter with the same confirmation strings, exception log text and shutdown control flow.

proposals.note: Descriptive name for the anonymous ClientUI exit WindowAdapter; no original anonymous-class identifier is claimed.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/ui/h is created only by ClientUI with a captured delegate LayoutManager and JComponent, then installed on that component.
It forwards add/remove/preferred/minimum/layout to the wrapped LayoutManager, then repositions the reviewed ClientTitleToolbar using its preferred width and the component's current width/height.
The class is an implementation helper around ClientUI layout rather than a self-identifying domain object, so the proposed name is intentionally descriptive.

proposals.note: Descriptive helper name for the ClientUI layout wrapper; exact bytecode proves role but not an original source identifier.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/ui/d is constructed exclusively by rs/ui/c, already reviewed as ClientTitleToolbar, and installed as that panel's LayoutManager2.
Its preferred size is componentCount*27 by 23; layout advances by 4 pixels, clamps child height to 23, centers vertically and assigns each child a 23-pixel width.

The class is a package-private helper with only layout-manager behavior and a captured ClientTitleToolbar owner; the proposed name is descriptive source-parity rather than an original identifier claim.

proposals.note: Descriptive helper name anchored to exact ClientTitleToolbar ownership and complete layout behavior.
